title: 預防接種紀錄與接種證明補發
summary: 兒童預防接種紀錄卡遺失或入學、出國需要接種證明時，可至衛生所或原接種院所申請補發，也可透過健康存摺查詢下載接種紀錄。
introMarkdown:
國內接種紀錄登錄於全國性預防接種資訊管理系統（NIIS）。需要接種紀錄時：

- **自行查詢**：透過健保快易通 APP「健康存摺」查詢與下載。
- **兒童接種紀錄卡補發**：攜帶兒童健保卡與家長身分證件至戶籍地或居住地衛生所申請。
- **英文接種證明**（留學、出國）：至衛生所或原接種院所申請，部分院所收取工本費。
requiredDocuments: 被接種者健保卡或身分證明
代理申請者身分證明與關係證明

steps.title: 先自行查詢
steps.text: 以健康存摺查詢是否已有完整紀錄。

steps.title: 臨櫃申請
steps.text: 攜帶證件至衛生所或原接種院所。

steps.title: 查核 NIIS 紀錄
steps.text: 比對系統紀錄，缺漏者協助向原接種單位查證。

steps.title: 核發
steps.text: 當場或於查證後核發紀錄卡／證明。

fee: 紀錄卡補發免費；英文證明工本費依各單位公告
legalBasis: 預防接種作業與兒童預防接種紀錄檢查辦法（示意）

forms.label: 預防接種紀錄補發申請書

contact: 疾病管制署急性傳染病組（總機 02-2395-9825）；一般諮詢請撥防疫專線 1922（國外 +886-800-001922）；補發請洽各地衛生所

faq.q: 小時候的紀錄查不到怎麼辦？
faq.a: 早年紀錄可能未電子化，可洽原戶籍地衛生所查詢紙本；確實無紀錄者，可由醫師評估補接種或抽血檢驗抗體。

faq.q: 新冠疫苗接種證明怎麼取得？
faq.a: 可透過健康存摺下載接種紀錄，或至接種院所申請紙本。

en.title: Vaccination record and vaccination certificate reissue
en.summary: If a child's vaccination record card is lost, or a vaccination certificate is needed for school or travel, apply for a reissue at the public health centre or the original vaccination site; records can also be viewed and downloaded through My Health Bank.
en.introMarkdown:
Vaccination records in Taiwan are kept in the national immunization information system (NIIS). To obtain your records:

- **Look them up yourself**: view and download them in "My Health Bank" in the NHI Express App.
- **Reissue of a child's vaccination record card**: bring the child's NHI card and the parent's ID to the public health centre where you are registered or live.
- **English vaccination certificate** (for study or travel abroad): apply at a public health centre or the original vaccination site; some sites charge a handling fee.
requiredDocuments: NHI card or ID of the person vaccinated
ID of the applicant acting on their behalf, with proof of the relationship
A copy of the passport (for an English certificate)

steps.title: Check your records yourself first
steps.text: Use My Health Bank to see whether a complete record already exists.

steps.title: Apply in person
steps.text: Bring your documents to a public health centre or the original vaccination site.

steps.title: Check the NIIS record
steps.text: Staff compare the system record; where entries are missing, they help verify with the original vaccination site.

steps.title: Issue
steps.text: The record card or certificate is issued on the spot or after verification.

en.fee: Reissue of the record card is free; the handling fee for an English certificate is set by each site.
en.contact: Taiwan CDC Division of Acute Infectious Diseases (switchboard +886-2-2395-9825); for general enquiries call the 1922 hotline (from abroad +886-800-001922); for reissue, contact your local public health centre.
legalBasis: Regulations on Vaccination Operations and Inspection of Children's Vaccination Records (illustrative)

forms.label: Application form for reissue of vaccination records

faq.q: What if my childhood records cannot be found?
faq.a: Older records may not have been digitised. Ask the public health centre of your original household registration about paper records. If there is truly no record, a physician can assess whether to revaccinate or to check antibody levels by blood test.

faq.q: How do I get proof of COVID-19 vaccination?
faq.a: Download the record from My Health Bank, or ask the vaccination site for a paper copy.

tl.title: Muling pag-isyu ng talaan at sertipiko ng pagbabakuna
tl.summary: Kung nawala ang card ng talaan ng pagbabakuna ng bata, o kailangan ng sertipiko ng pagbabakuna para sa paaralan o paglalakbay, mag-apply ng muling pag-isyu sa health center o sa orihinal na lugar ng pagbabakuna; maaari ring tingnan at i-download ang talaan sa My Health Bank.

vi.title: Cấp lại sổ và giấy chứng nhận tiêm chủng
vi.summary: Khi mất sổ tiêm chủng của trẻ hoặc cần giấy chứng nhận tiêm chủng để nhập học, xuất ngoại, có thể xin cấp lại tại trạm y tế hoặc cơ sở đã tiêm; cũng có thể tra cứu và tải hồ sơ tiêm chủng qua My Health Bank.

id.title: Penerbitan ulang catatan dan sertifikat vaksinasi
id.summary: Jika kartu catatan vaksinasi anak hilang atau diperlukan sertifikat vaksinasi untuk sekolah atau perjalanan, ajukan penerbitan ulang di puskesmas atau tempat vaksinasi semula; catatan juga dapat dilihat dan diunduh melalui My Health Bank.

th.title: การออกบัตรบันทึกและใบรับรองการฉีดวัคซีนใหม่
th.summary: หากบัตรบันทึกการฉีดวัคซีนของเด็กสูญหาย หรือต้องใช้ใบรับรองการฉีดวัคซีนสำหรับเข้าเรียนหรือเดินทางไปต่างประเทศ ยื่นขอออกใหม่ได้ที่ศูนย์สาธารณสุขหรือสถานที่ที่ฉีดวัคซีนเดิม และดูหรือดาวน์โหลดประวัติได้ทาง My Health Bank
